Assistant A did not provide any answers to the user's questions, so it's not possible to evaluate its responses.

Assistant B provided correct and helpful answers to both of the user's questions. The responses were in line with the reference answers. The assistant correctly explained the Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm for finding the majority element in an array and also correctly modified the algorithm to find the top-2 most occurring elements in an array. The assistant also provided the time and space complexity of the algorithms, which is an added bonus.

Therefore, the final verdict is: [[B]]
